nodes.description: Public constant string 'DU30 0.1' describing the token version.
Public token name string assigned in the constructor.
Public token symbol string assigned in the constructor.
Public uint8 number of decimals assigned in the constructor.
Total token supply; written in the constructor and incremented in the payable fallback.
Mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spending allowances.
Mapping(address => withdrawalRequest) storing sinceTime and amount used by the notPendingWithdrawal modifier.
Constant initial supply equal to 50000000.
Constructor that mints initialSupply to msg.sender and sets name, symbol and decimals.
ERC20 transfer guarded by the notPendingWithdrawal modifier; updates balanceOf and emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve guarded by notPendingWithdrawal; writes allowance and emits Approval.
Approves the spender and then performs a low-level external call to receiveApproval.
ERC20 transferFrom that spends allowance and updates balances for _from and _to.
Payable fallback with notPendingWithdrawal; mints tokens equal to msg.value and grows totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner, modifier lookup key and mint recipient.
Low-level _spender.call(bytes4(sha3('receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes)')), ...) sending control flow to an arbitrary address before state settles.
Constructor parameter tokenName written into the name state variable.
Constructor parameter decimalUnits written into the decimals state variable.
Constructor parameter tokenSymbol written into the symbol state variable.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer used to update balanceOf.
Spender parameter of approve used as allowance key.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Spender parameter of approveAndCall; target of the external call.
Approval amount parameter of approveAndCall forwarded to the external call.
Arbitrary bytes payload forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used for balance and allowance updates.
Local variable holding msg.value in the payable fallback before minting.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter tokenName flows into state assignment name = tokenName.
Constructor parameter decimalUnits flows into decimals = decimalUnits.
Constructor parameter tokenSymbol flows into symbol = tokenSymbol.
Recipient parameter _to is used to credit balanceOf[_to] and called in the modifier check.
Amount parameter _value drives the balanceOf sender/target updates in transfer.
Spender parameter _spender keys the allowance write in approve.
Value parameter _value is stored in allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Spender parameter _spender is the target address of the low-level call.
Value parameter _value is approved and forwarded to the external call.
Arbitrary bytes _extraData is attached to the external call payload.
Source parameter _from keys balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
Destination parameter _to is credited in transferFrom.
Amount parameter _value is debited from balances and allowance.
msg.sender becomes the recipient of initialSupply in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the key for balanceOf reads and writes in transfer, fallback and transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as owner key in allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender indexes withdrawalRequests in the notPendingWithdrawal modifier, whose sinceTime acts as a time-based access gate.
initialSupply * 1000000000000000000 assigns totalSupply and can overflow or mis-scale.
Constructor multiplication initialSupply * 1e18 writes totalSupply without overflow checks.
msg.value is copied into the local amount inside the payable fallback.
amount is added to balanceOf[msg.sender] with += in the fallback, unchecked addition.
amount is added to totalSupply with += in the fallback, unchecked addition.
_value is subtracted from and added to balanceOf entries in transfer.
_value is written into the allowance mapping in approve.
_value is passed as an argument to the external receiveApproval call.
_spender controls which external address is invoked by the low-level call, enabling reentrancy into the contract.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] and added to balanceOf[_to] in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
approveAndCall invokes the internal approve function before performing the external call.
approveAndCall transfers control to the untrusted _spender contract through the low-level call.
The notPendingWithdrawal modifier reads withdrawalRequests[msg.sender].sinceTime, a time-based lock, before execution.
transfer is gated by the notPendingWithdrawal modifier reading withdrawalRequests sinceTime.
approve is gated by the notPendingWithdrawal modifier reading withdrawalRequests sinceTime.
The payable fallback is gated by the notPendingWithdrawal modifier reading withdrawalRequests sinceTime.
transferFrom consults withdrawalRequests[_from].sinceTime and withdrawalRequests[_to].sinceTime as time-based access checks.
The external call can re-enter approveAndCall through the receiveApproval callback.
The invoked contract can call back into transfer while approveAndCall state is still in flight.
The invoked contract can call back into approve, mutating allowance during the external call.
The invoked contract can send ether and re-enter the payable fallback during the external call.

Parameter _to exists only to feed the balanceOf updates inside transfer.
Parameter _value exists only to feed the arithmetic updates inside transfer.
Parameter _spender exists only to key the allowance write inside approve.
Parameter _value exists only to be stored by approve.
Parameter _spender determines the target of the unsafe low-level call in approveAndCall.
Parameter _value is forwarded into the unsafe external call and the approval it precedes.
Parameter _extraData is forwarded as opaque payload to the unsafe external call.
